## Results (key numbers)

**Combined (15 min, wild type)**

- Fisher test phospho vs protein: 3/131 (2.3 %) vs 35/2003 (1.7 %), OR = 1.32,
  p = 0.42 (one-sided) -> not significant; low power (only 3 changed sites)
- the 3 changed sites (`TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc`; diff < 0 = higher after PASN):
  - B7H15_05655 T21 (hypothetical protein): diff = +2.43 (~5x **lower** after PASN),
    protein unchanged (-0.31) -> real dephosphorylation; transient (back at ~15 h)
  - B7H15_01690 S33 (5'-nucleotidase, lipoprotein): diff = -2.42 (~5x **higher**
    after PASN), protein unchanged (+0.11) -> real phosphorylation; stays high at ~15 h
  - IsaA S194: diff = -2.80, but protein also -1.87 (FDR 7e-8) -> mostly more protein;
    only 2/3 replicates in TSB and SN
- T21 and S33 were detected in **3/3 replicates in every medium** (no imputation)

**Proteome (notebook 08)**

- 35 changed proteins at 15 min: 27 higher, 8 lower after PASN
- top 6 by smallest FDR (notebook 07) ≠ top 6 by largest |log2FC| (notebook 08);
  only AdhE (B7H15_00850) and anaerobic ribonucleotide reductase (B7H15_14555) are in both
- largest changes also include a cold-shock protein (B7H15_15050, up at 15 min,
  below TSB at ~15 h), sulfurtransferase (B7H15_14960) and delta-hemolysin
  (B7H15_11280, **lower** after PASN, further down at ~15 h)
- AraC family regulator (B7H15_03730): large change but noisy (2/3 in TSB, wide spread)

**Phospho without the 2/3 filter (Michelle, combined section 9)**

- 15 min: 170 testable sites without the filter vs 131 with it -> still **3** significant
- sites only after the pulse: 366 (335 in 1/3, 24 in 2/3, 7 in 3/3)
- sites only in TSB: 814 (625 in 1/3, 147 in 2/3, 42 in 3/3)
- detected sites per sample: JE2anc_TSB_1 = 977, all other TSB/pulse samples 347–484
  -> the many TSB-only sites are probably partly a depth effect of one sample

**Literature**

- no paper found on a 15 min PASN pulse (proteome or phosphoproteome)
- Schwyter et al. 2025 (mSystems, doi:10.1128/msystems.00262-25): JE2 18 h in 30 % PA
  supernatant, 335 changed proteins (≈ 19 %); virulence factors and transporters down,
  ROS scavengers up -> reference for our ~15 h
- Huemer et al. 2023 (Sci. Signal., doi:10.1126/scisignal.abj8194): most changes only
  in the phosphoproteome, not the total proteome (pH stress, stp/pknB mutants)
- Filkins et al. 2015 (J. Bacteriol., doi:10.1128/JB.00059-15): co-culture with
  *P. aeruginosa* drives *S. aureus* towards fermentation (HQNO) -> fits our early
  fermentation enzymes, but co-culture and mRNA, not supernatant and protein

## Problems / surprises

- replicate counts differ between notebooks: Michelle 122 reliable sites
  (`read_sites()`), combined 131 (`read_abundances()`) -> use one source
- one deep TSB sample (TSB_1) makes presence/absence counts unbalanced
- "top 6" depends on how you sort (FDR vs fold change) -> state it in Methods
- product names (NCBI automatic annotation) are often vague -> functions must be
  checked in UniProt via the NCTC 8325 ortholog (`staa8_uniprot`)
- git push was rejected ("non-fast-forward"); commits stayed local until we pulled
  and pushed again from the terminal; the GitHub repository had been renamed
